tests.name: A tool resolving with "" gives executeTool() the JSON string "" (two quote characters).
A tool resolving with the string "hi" gives executeTool() its JSON serialization, "hi" with quotes.
A tool resolving with undefined makes executeTool() reject with OperationError: undefined has no JSON serialization.
tests.message: assert_unreached: Should have rejected: undefined Reached unreachable code

tests.name: A Tool exposes an absent inputSchema, outputSchema and annotations as null, not undefined.
tests.message: assert_equals: inputSchema is null when absent expected (object) null but got (undefined) undefined

tests.name: Input whose JSON serialization is not an object (here an object whose toJSON() returns 5) makes executeTool() reject with DataError.
tests.message: promise_rejects_dom: function "function() { throw e; }" threw object "UnknownError: Failed to parse input arguments" that is not a DOMException DataError: property "name" is equal to "UnknownError", expected "DataError"

tests.name: A Tool exposes the outputSchema it was registered with, and annotations with every hint defaulted to false.
registerTool() rejects with TypeError when outputSchema can't be serialized to JSON, as it does for inputSchema.
tests.message: assert_unreached: Should have rejected: undefined Reached unreachable code

tests.name: A Tool taken from getTools() whose registration was aborted must not run the tool that later reuses its name.
tests.message: assert_unreached: Should have rejected: undefined Reached unreachable code

tests.name: A tool whose callback rejects makes executeTool() reject with OperationError.
tests.message: promise_rejects_dom: function "function() { throw e; }" threw object "UnknownError: Tool was executed but the invocation failed. For example, the script function threw an error" that is not a DOMException OperationError: property "name" is equal to "UnknownError", expected "OperationError"

tests.name: Executing a Tool whose registration was aborted rejects with NotFoundError.
tests.message: promise_rejects_dom: function "function() { throw e; }" threw object "UnknownError: The operation failed for an unknown transient reason (e.g. out of memory)." that is not a DOMException NotFoundError: property "code" is equal to 0, expected 8
